columnHelp.name: Human-readable title in lists and exports.
columnHelp.unitNumber: Unit number or code inside the block (apartment, lot).
columnHelp.frontM2: Frontage length in metres (linear), not surface.
columnHelp.depthM2: Lot depth in metres (linear), not surface.
columnHelp.parkingSizeM2: Parking area in m². Formula: Parking Spaces × 12.5 m².
columnHelp.totalSizeM2: Unit + parking footprint in m². Formula: Unit Size (mts²) + Parking Size (mts²).
columnHelp.habitableConstructionM2: Area used to calculate price/rent per m². Possible formulas: • Vertical: Unit Size (mts²) + Balcony/Terrace (mts²) • Horizontal: Same as Unit Size (mts²) • Lot: Same as Land (mts²) Active formula ({formula}): {activeFormula}.
columnHelp.frontVaras2: Frontage length in varas (linear), not surface.
columnHelp.depthVaras2: Lot depth in varas (linear), not surface.
columnHelp.parkingSizeVaras2: Parking area in varas². Formula: Parking Spaces × 17.89 varas² per space.
columnHelp.totalSizeVaras2: Unit + parking footprint in varas². Formula: Unit Size (varas²) + Parking Size (varas²).
columnHelp.habitableConstructionVaras2: Area used to calculate price/rent per varas². Possible formulas: • Vertical: Unit Size (varas²) + Balcony/Terrace (varas²) • Horizontal: Same as Unit Size (varas²) • Lot: Same as Land (varas²) Active formula ({formula}): {activeFormula}.
columnHelp.dimensionVaras2Calculated: This dimension in varas² for the same row. Formula: Fixed conversion.
columnHelp.dimensionM2Calculated: This dimension in metres for the same row. Formula: Fixed conversion.
columnHelp.hasMotorcycleParking: Whether the unit includes motorcycle parking. You can edit this only when Has Parking is Yes.
columnHelp.parkingType: Parking layout from the catalog. You can edit this only when Has Parking is Yes.
columnHelp.parkingSpaces: Number of car parking spaces. You can edit this only when Has Parking is Yes.
columnHelp.vatRateDisplay: VAT factor applied to this unit. Read-only — computed client-side. Rules: Interior+Lot → 1.12 · Usage Rental → 1.12 · Usage Sale → 0.916 · Default → 1.12.
columnHelp.unitType: Strapi dynamic zone: residential, office, or industrial. One component per unit. Double-click to choose; saves as unitType on the API.
columnHelp.totalPriceUSD: Total sale price (VAT included). VAT rate by unit: {vatRate}.
columnHelp.priceWithoutVATUSD: Price before VAT. Formula: Total Price (USD) ÷ VAT rate. VAT rate by unit: {vatRate}.
columnHelp.pricePerM2USD: Net price per habitable m². Formula: Price without VAT (USD) ÷ Habitable Construction (mts²).
columnHelp.rentalPriceWithoutVATUSD: Rent before VAT. Formula: Rental Price (USD) ÷ VAT rate. VAT rate by unit: {vatRate}.
columnHelp.rentalPricePerM2WithoutVATUSD: Rent per habitable m² without VAT. Formula: Rental without VAT (USD) ÷ Habitable Construction (mts²).
columnHelp.maintenanceTotalPriceM2USD: Total maintenance (VAT included). VAT rate by unit: {vatRate}.
columnHelp.maintenanceWithoutVATUSD: Maintenance before VAT. Formula: Maintenance Total (USD) ÷ VAT rate. VAT rate by unit: {vatRate}.
columnHelp.maintenancePricePerM2USD: Maintenance per habitable m² without VAT. Formula: Maintenance without VAT (USD) ÷ Habitable Construction (mts²).
columnHelp.installmentUSD: Estimated monthly loan payment. Formula ({country}): PMT on {loanPct} of Price without VAT (USD), {years} years, {ratePct} annual.
columnHelp.foreignPriceWithoutVAT: Price before VAT. Formula: Total Price ({currency}) ÷ VAT rate.
columnHelp.foreignPricePerM2: Net price per habitable m². Formula: Price without VAT ({currency}) ÷ Habitable Construction (mts²).
columnHelp.foreignRentalPriceWithoutVAT: Rent before VAT. Formula: Rental Price ({currency}) ÷ VAT rate.
columnHelp.foreignRentalPricePerM2WithoutVAT: Rent per habitable m² without VAT. Formula: Rental without VAT ({currency}) ÷ Habitable Construction (mts²).
columnHelp.foreignMaintenanceWithoutVAT: Maintenance before VAT. Formula: Maintenance Total ({currency}) ÷ VAT rate.
columnHelp.foreignMaintenancePricePerM2: Maintenance per habitable m² without VAT. Formula: Maintenance without VAT ({currency}) ÷ Habitable Construction (mts²).
columnHelp.foreignInstallment: Estimated monthly loan payment. Formula: PMT on 90% of Price without VAT ({currency}), 20 years, 7.5% annual.
columnHelp.usdReadonlyWhileForeignCurrency: Amounts in US dollars. Select USD in the currency toolbar to edit these cells.
columnHelp.absorptionPerM2: Absorption weighted by habitable size. Formula: Unit Absorption × Habitable Construction (mts²).
columnHelp.documentId: API document id for this unit (server-assigned).
columnHelp.documentIdSuperAdmin: API document id for this unit (server-assigned).
columnHelp.housingBedrooms:
Number of bedrooms for the residential unit.



This column only applies when the unit type is housing/residential.
columnHelp.housingBalconyTerraceM2:
Private balcony and terrace area in m² (outdoor space tied to the unit).



This column only applies when the unit type is housing/residential.
columnHelp.officesBalconyTerraceM2:
Private balcony and terrace area in m² for the office unit.



Only when unit type is office (Strapi component unit-types.offices).
columnHelp.officesEmployeeCapacity: Typical number of employees the layout supports (integer). API field employeeCapacity. Office units only.
columnHelp.officesParkingSpacesSale: Count of parking spaces offered with the unit (for sale). API parkingForSale. Office units only.
columnHelp.officesPricePerM2ExParkingUsd: Asking price per m² in USD excluding parking. API priceWithoutParkingM2USD. Office units only.
columnHelp.officesPropertyValueExParkingUsd: Total property value in USD excluding parking. API propertyValueWithoutParkingUSD. Office units only.
columnHelp.officesOfficeClass: Office classification (Strapi enum officeClassification). Allowed values from the API: Micro 1, Micro 2, Small 1, Small 2, Medium 1, Medium 2, Medium 3, Large 1, Large 2, Large 3, Large 4, Large 5. Double-click to pick; the grid stores the exact API string.
columnHelp.officesSizeCategory: General size classification (enum generalSizeClassification): Micro, Small, Medium, Large. Double-click to choose.
columnHelp.officesStaffCapacityRange: Employee capacity band (enum employeeCapacityRange). API tokens such as Range_1_To_5 … Range_More_Than_171; the header tooltip lists human-readable bands. Double-click to choose.
columnHelp.officesAreaRange: Free-text floor area band or marketing range (m2Range). Not a closed enum in the API.
columnHelp.officesSizeStaffSummary: Combined size + staffing summary string (sizeEmployeeCapacityCombined). Typically derived or display text.
columnHelp.officesSizeAreaSummary: Combined size + m² summary string (sizeM2Combined). Typically derived or display text.
columnHelp.generic: Unit field; the currency toolbar or other rules may lock the cell.

welcome.title: Welcome to Projects
welcome.description: This is the main section to manage all your real estate projects. Here you can view, create, edit and manage all projects in the system.

search.title: Quick search
search.description: Use this search bar to quickly find projects by name, developer, code or any field. The search updates automatically as you type.

filters.title: Advanced filters
filters.description: Click here to open advanced filters. You can create complex filters combining multiple fields with logical operators (AND/OR) to find exactly what you're looking for.

create.title: Create new project
create.description: This button allows you to create a new project from scratch. Fill out the form with project information and save it to the system.

table.title: Projects table
table.description: Here you'll see all your projects in table format. You can sort by any column by clicking the header. Use pagination at the bottom to navigate between pages.

actions.title: Available actions
actions.description: Each project has available actions: View details, Edit (modify existing data) and Clone (create a copy with pre-filled data). The difference: Edit modifies the current project, Clone creates a new one based on this one.

welcome.title: Welcome to Blocks
welcome.description: Blocks are subdivisions within a project. Here you manage all real estate blocks, each associated with a specific project.

search.title: Block search
search.description: Search blocks by name, code, phase, tower or sector. The search is instant and updates as you type.

create.title: Create new block
create.description: Create a new block associated with a project. Blocks organize units within a project by phase, tower or sector.

table.title: Blocks table
table.description: View all blocks with their main information: code, name, associated project, phase, tower, sector and number of units.

actions.title: Block actions
actions.description: From here you can View block units, Edit the block (modify data) or Clone the block (create a new one with similar data).

welcome.title: Welcome to Units
welcome.description: Units are individual properties within a block. You must first select a block to view and manage its units.

select.title: Select block
select.description: Search and select the block from which you want to view units. Once selected, you'll be able to view and edit all units of that block in an interactive table.

toolbar.title: Toolbar
toolbar.description: This toolbar contains all main actions: Undo/Redo changes, Add new rows, Save changes, Sync data from server and Search in the table. The status indicator shows if there are pending or saved changes.

table.title: Units table
table.description: This is an Excel-like table where you can edit cells directly by double-clicking. You can copy and paste data, sort columns, filter and group. Changes are saved automatically when editing existing cells, but new rows require clicking 'Save'.

welcome.title: Welcome to Catalogs
welcome.description: Catalogs are master lists of system data such as amenities, services, countries, developers, etc. Here you manage these reference data.

types.title: Catalog types
types.description: Catalogs are organized by type: Projects, Blocks and Units. Each type contains different related catalogs. Click on a type to see its catalogs.

list.title: Catalog list
list.description: Once a type is selected, you'll see all available catalogs. Click on a catalog to manage its items (create, edit, delete).

create.title: Create item
create.description: This button allows you to add new items to the selected catalog. Catalog items can be used in projects, blocks and units.

sync.title: Data operations
sync.subtitle: Run and monitor bulk operations over projects and blocks.
sync.errorTitle: Could not reach the sync service
sync.emptyDescription: Once you trigger a synchronisation, its progress and history show up here.
sync.noBlocksDescription: The run finished without getting to process any blocks.
sync.stopConfirmWhat: The run is marked failed, its outstanding blocks are closed and the lock is released, so you can trigger another one.
sync.stopConfirmCaveat: Blocks already writing will finish: this closes the ledger, not the writes in flight. Wait a few minutes before launching another synchronisation.
sync.newRunDescription: Choose what to move and which way. It starts right away and continues in the background.
sync.allBlocksHint: Turn it off to pick projects.
sync.willBeRecordedAs: It will be recorded as requested by {user}.
sync.startConflict: An operation is already running. Wait for it to finish or stop it.
sync.blocksTruncated: Hit the {max}-block cap; narrow the filters.
sync.filesDescription: Backups and results the run left in S3, organised by block.
sync.filesTruncated: The run holds more than {cap} objects; the listing is cut short.
sync.noFilesDescription: Nothing in this folder. A run that failed while resolving targets never gets as far as writing backups.
sync.fileRestorableHint: The block's first attempt: the only backup guaranteed to predate the write. Restore from this one.
sync.fileRetryHint: A retry: taken when the previous attempt may already have written. Restoring from this one can reinstate the new data instead of the old.
sync.fileTooLarge: The file is over {max} MB and is not rendered here — it would freeze the tab. Download it to inspect it.
sync.selectionEmpty: Nothing selected yet. Expand a project and pick its blocks, or tick the whole project.
sync.removeProject: Remove this project from the selection
sync.operationPushHint: Sends what you edited in the admin.
sync.operationPullHint: Brings in what the database has.
sync.operationPurgeHint: Removes projects and blocks with their units.
sync.diffSubtitle: Previous backup against what was written, attempt {exec}.
sync.diffNoChanges: No changes: what was written is identical to what was already there.
sync.diffRowAdded: new row, did not exist before
sync.operationPullPreview: Preview only: you can browse the warehouse, but a pull cannot run yet
sync.pullPreviewBanner: Pull preview. You are seeing the warehouse blocks (MySQL), which is where the data would come from. It cannot run yet.
sync.pullWarning: The database wins: units missing from it are deleted in the admin, including any you created by hand.
sync.phaseCatalogsHint: Resolved or created before anything is written
sync.operationOnlyHousing: This action does not run for this property type yet.
sync.allBlocksWarningPush: The whole universe will be sent. Blocks that exist only in the admin will be created in the database, and that cannot be undone.
sync.allBlocksWarningPull: Every block of this property type will be brought in. It is a long run.
